entries.title: I Corinthians 6:1
segments: ¶Dare any one of you, having a matter against another, prosecute his suit before the unjust, and not before the saints?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:2
segments: Do ye not then know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world is judged by you, are ye unworthy of [the] smallest judgments?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:3
segments: Do ye not know that we shall judge angels? and not then matters of this life?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:4
segments: If then ye have judgments as to things of this life, set those [to judge] who are little esteemed in the assembly.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:5
segments: I speak to you [to put you] to shame. Thus there is not a wise person among you, not even one, who shall be able to decide between his brethren!

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:6
segments: But brother prosecutes his suit with brother, and that before unbelievers.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:7
segments: Already indeed then it is altogether a fault in you that ye have suits between yourselves. Why do ye not rather suffer wrong? why are ye not rather defrauded?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:8
segments: But *ye* do wrong, and defraud, and this [your] brethren.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:9
segments: ¶Do ye not know that unrighteous [persons] shall not inherit [the] kingdom of God? Do not err: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor those who make women of themselves, nor who abuse themselves with men,

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:10
segments: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor abusive persons, nor [the] rapacious, shall inherit [the] kingdom of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:11
segments: And these things were some of you; but ye have been washed, but ye have been sanctified, but ye have been justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:12
segments: ¶All things are lawful to me, but all things do not profit; all things are lawful to me, but *I* will not be brought under the power of any.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:13
segments: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats; but God will bring to nothing both it and them: but the body [is] not for fornication, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:14
segments: And God has both raised up the Lord, and will raise us up from among [the dead] by his power.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:15
segments: Do ye not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then, taking the members of the Christ, make [them] members of a harlot? Far be the thought.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:16
segments: Do ye not know that he [that is] joined to the harlot is one body? for the two, he says, shall be one flesh.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:17
segments: But he that [is] joined to the Lord is one Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:18
segments: Flee fornication. Every sin which a man may practise is without the body, but he that commits fornication sins against his own body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:19
segments: Do ye not know that your body is [the] temple of the Holy Spirit which [is] in you, which ye have of God; and ye are not your own?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:20
segments: for ye have been bought with a price: glorify now then God in your body.
